name: Barrios de Colina (Spain)
description: Square red flag with a white triangle at the upper fly and a green triangle at the lower hoist, charged towards the hoist with the crowned municipal arms of Barrios de Colina (a saint, a scallop and a tree).
history: Municipal flag of Barrios de Colina; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Barrios de Colina arms — saint, scallop and tree
